_meta.what: What people say BECAUSE OF WHAT YOU DID -- keyed to standing, to whether they saw it or only heard it, and to what they remember of you.
_meta.why: Depth is reactivity. Hades ships ~21,020 reactive lines because the game knows what you just did and who saw it. Bohemia computes both already (bohemia_standing.js RUNGS, bohemia_deeds.js witness(), bohemia_people.js makeLedger) and had no words for any of it.

study.title: W6/W7/W9 (narrative consistency + persistent reputation + pursuing consequence
